title: Make generated public state reproducible locally and in CI
objective: Make local and CI validation independently prove that the disposable public projection is byte-for-byte reproducible from one accepted commit, without wall-clock races or claims that ignored output must be committed.
acceptance: public generated_at metadata is derived deterministically from the accepted Git commit rather than the build wall clock
two public builds separated across wall-clock seconds are byte-for-byte identical
make check validates, builds, tests, audits, compares independent builds, and rejects source-tree drift from a clean checkout
local and CI validation implement the same generated-state contract
documentation describes generated/public as ignored disposable output rather than tracked state
deployment time remains separately observable in provider runs and activation receipts
limitations: This task does not change protected schema or policy identifiers.
The public generated_at field represents the accepted source frontier time, not the later provider deployment time.
